note: Hand-compiled. Major state and local incentive packages for Southeast plants announced since 2015, as reported at the time. Investment and jobs are company commitments, not results. Packages mix grants, tax breaks, land and site work, and are counted differently from deal to deal; see each source.

deals.note: About $380M state and $320M Huntsville. Investment includes an $830M addition in 2020. The plant built its millionth vehicle in October 2026.
About $135M state, $123M Baldwin County and $5M Bay Minette; the total also counts about $75M of county site work.
State package of more than $50M, including a $30M investment credit. A 2026 expansion added about $14M in state credits.
State and local package of about $1.8B.
Georgia's largest package at the time: land and site work plus about $700M of county tax breaks over 25 years. Targets due by the end of 2028.

deals.company: Hyundai and SK On battery plant
deals.note: Grants, tax breaks and free infrastructure from the state and local governments. Battery production began in 2026.
Includes a $500M construction grant and $200M for a highway interchange. In December 2025 Ford said it would repurpose the EV assembly plant.
South Carolina's largest package, including $400M toward construction. Volkswagen owes up to $790M back if targets are missed. A 2026 report put the state's costs $150M over budget.
Paid for site work, roads and utilities. The job goal is not binding. The plant opened in 2025.
Includes $135M for Florence County and $120M for infrastructure, training and site prep. A further $111M was promised for a second plant.
Tax incentives approved by the Legislature.
Up to $482M in state incentives for a battery venture of Cummins (Accelera), Daimler Truck and PACCAR. In September 2026 the company cut staff and delayed production.
